config.thermalsystems.title: Thermal Systems Configuration
config.thermalsystems.systemEnabled.desc: Master on/off switch, also surfaced by the persistent Thermal Systems control panel HUD's own toggle.
config.thermalsystems.heatTransferCoeffi: Scales heat source contribution to effectiveConvergenceRate.
config.thermalsystems.defaultTargetTempe: Target temperature, in Celsius, for a newly created zone when none is specified.
config.thermalsystems.loggingEnabled.des: Master switch gating per-interval log output. When off, silences everything below regardless of the sub-flags.
config.thermalsystems.radiationLoggingEn: Gates SourceRadiationTickHandler/ActiveSourcePositions logging. Only takes effect when Logging Enabled is also on.
config.thermalsystems.radiationDebugEnab: Emits the direct-radiation handler's per-interval, per-player diagnostics at DEBUG level. Off by default; /thermal debug radiation shows the same state on demand.
config.thermalsystems.radiationChangeEps: Smallest difference, in Celsius, between a player's direct-radiation temperature and the last one logged that counts as a change worth logging.
config.thermalsystems.bindingLoggingEnab: Gates ZoneSourceScanner/ZoneSourceBindingTickHandler logging. Only takes effect when Logging Enabled is also on.
config.thermalsystems.defaultAmbientTemp: Temperature reported to bridges for a player not inside any bounded zone.
config.thermalsystems.sourceBindingRadiu: Blocks beyond a bounded zone's edges to scan for foreign heat/cooling source capabilities to auto-bind.
config.thermalsystems.sourceScanInterval: Ticks between automatic zone source-binding scans.
config.thermalsystems.sourceRadiationRad: Chebyshev-distance blocks a tracked heat/cooling source radiates directly to nearby players, independent of any zone.
config.thermalsystems.sourceRadiationInt: Ticks between direct source-to-player radiation applications.
config.thermalsystems.sourceTrackingReve: Ticks between periodic re-verification passes that re-check tracked source positions still resolve to the expected block type, independent of chunk load/unload event timing.
config.thermalsystems.hoverTooltipsEnabl: Gates the integration network hover tooltips (Ender IO, Mekanism, PneumaticCraft).
config.thermalsystems.pneumaticcraftRefe: Baseline temperature, in Kelvin, for Thermal Exchanger conversion.
config.thermalsystems.pneumaticcraftExch: Scales the Kelvin difference from the reference temperature into Thermal Systems heat/cooling output.
config.thermalsystems.mekanismReferenceT: Baseline temperature, in Kelvin, for Mekanism Heat Exchanger conversion. Matches Mekanism's own ambient temperature by default.
config.thermalsystems.mekanismConversion: Scales the Kelvin difference from the reference temperature into Thermal Systems heat/cooling output.
config.thermalsystems.mekanismNetworkRec: Ticks a Mekanism cable network's heat/cooling sum is cached for before being recomputed on next read.
config.thermalsystems.enderioCoolingMode: Generators inside a zone follow that zone's thermostat (heating, cooling or standby). This switch only decides what generators outside any zone do: on = they cool nearby players, off = they heat them.
config.thermalsystems.enderioEnergyToHea: Scales the FE an Ender IO Stirling Generator currently holds in storage into Thermal Systems heat output.
config.thermalsystems.enderioOutputMulti: Direct intensity knob applied on top of the Energy to Heat Coefficient to scale the final Ender IO heat/cooling output hotter or colder, with no pretense of physical accuracy.
config.thermalsystems.enderioNetworkReco: Ticks an Ender IO conduit network's heat sum is cached for before being recomputed on next read.
config.thermalsystems.lsoTemperatureOffs: Ambient temperature, in Celsius, treated as Legendary Survival Overhaul's zero-delta neutral point. Matches TemperatureEnum.NORMAL's center by default.
config.thermalsystems.coldsweatEnabled.d: Config-level on/off switch for the Cold Sweat integration. Separate from whether Cold Sweat is actually installed - both must be true for the integration to activate.
config.thermalsystems.coldsweatTemperatu: Ambient temperature, in Celsius, treated as Cold Sweat's zero-delta neutral point. Matches Default Ambient Temperature by default.
config.thermalsystems.coldsweatOutputSca: Scales the Celsius delta from the neutral point into the small int strength Cold Sweat's WarmthTempModifier/FrigidnessTempModifier expect. A strength of 1 is already a strong effect against Cold Sweat's comfortable range, so this stays small - the default keeps a 10C delta at roughly strength 1.
config.thermalsystems.eclipticseasonsEna: Adds Ecliptic Seasons' solar-term temperature onto Default Ambient Temperature. Does nothing when Ecliptic Seasons is not installed. Applies as soon as it is changed.
config.thermalsystems.sereneseasonsEnabl: Adds Serene Seasons' sub-season temperature onto Default Ambient Temperature. Does nothing when Serene Seasons is not installed, or when Ecliptic Seasons is already supplying the season. Applies as soon as it is changed.
config.thermalsystems.toughasnailsEnable: Config-level on/off switch for the Tough As Nails integration. Separate from whether Tough As Nails is actually installed - both must be true for the integration to activate. Turning it off after startup stops the modifier from changing anything, but a restart is needed to fully unregister it.
config.thermalsystems.toughasnailsHeatOn: Degrees Celsius above Default Ambient Temperature (summed across all sources affecting a player) at which the player's Tough As Nails temperature rises by one level.
config.thermalsystems.toughasnailsHeatTw: Degrees Celsius above Default Ambient Temperature at which the player's Tough As Nails temperature rises by two levels. A player is never pushed into Hot from outside it - the result stops at Warm.
config.thermalsystems.toughasnailsCoolin: Degrees Celsius below Default Ambient Temperature (as a positive number) at which the player's Tough As Nails temperature drops by one level.

Degrees Celsius below Default Ambient Temperature (as a positive number) at which the player's Tough As Nails temperature drops by two levels. A player is never pushed into Icy from outside it - the result stops at Cold.
config.thermalsystems.importExport.expor: Share code ready - copy it above.
config.thermalsystems.importExport.impor: Loaded - click Apply to use it.
config.thermalsystems.zonesMaxZoneVolume: Largest zone (in blocks) a non-op player can mark out with the Zone Gadget.
config.thermalsystems.zonesMaxZonesPerPl: How many zones each non-op player may own. 0 = unlimited.
config.thermalsystems.zonesPlayerRoomRea: Blocks a player's feet may fall outside a zone's bounds and still count as standing in it. A zone marked out at floor level is only as tall as that box, so a player's feet - one block above the floor - can land just outside it. Keep this small so merely walking near a room isn't credited with its temperature.
config.thermalsystems.zonesMachineRoomRe: Blocks a fixed machine, conduit, or wall thermostat may sit outside a zone's bounds and still count as belonging to it - covers a generator or conduit run feeding a room from just outside its walls.
